purpose: 60 modular guild heraldry assets; 20 banners, 20 frames, 20 emblems. Replaces rejected wolf/dragon designs.
reference: User attached fantasy banner references; Pinterest pin 456693218469169079 could not be accessed.
packing: Connected alpha components isolate each of ten subjects per source without cutting at nominal grid boundaries. Small detached details assigned to nearest main subject; extraneous neighbor fragments excluded. Each subject is fitted within 448px and centered in an individual transparent 512px sprite. Six 5×2 sheets are kept as source previews; runtime uses 60 individual sprites to prevent SVG color-filter bleed.
